1.web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
1.asv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

2.web: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
2.asv: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

3.web: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
3.asv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day

4.web: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
4.asv: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

5.web: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you; which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also.
5.asv: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.

6.web: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
6.asv: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.

7.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
7.asv: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.

8.web: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
8.asv: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;

9.web: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
9.asv: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

10.web: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
10.asv: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,

11.web: For this, I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
11.asv: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.

12.web: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
12.asv: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.

13.web: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
13.asv: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

14.web: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
14.asv: That good thing which was committed unto thee guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.

15.web: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
15.asv: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

16.web: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
16.asv: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;

17.web: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me
17.asv: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

18.web: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
18.asv: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
